content.content: deccy undo undoes the last applied operation: the marker immediately before the position. Undo applies to whole operations only.
content.rationale: One step per invocation keeps undo total without a selector and lets a mistake be walked back further; whole-operation scope keeps every intermediate state a valid graph. The linear history (kpptprql) fixes which operation is last: it is markers[pos-1], and undo moves the position one back. The inverse is not fixed here: D8a makes a creation's undo a removal of the created node and a recording's or removal's a restoration, so this entry fixes which operation undo takes and that it takes it whole, and how it is undone follows the kind of operation undone.
